WHAT THE COMPARISON SUPPORTS

Observed price associations

The same matched transaction cohort is grouped by its nearest MRT exit, primary school or existing/interim hawker centre. The charts show full price distributions, counts and lease/accessibility combinations.

HOW TO READ IT FAIRLY

Context still matters

Distances use present-day coordinates with uploaded amenity snapshots. They do not reconstruct historic availability. Town, flat type, building age and housing mix can influence observed differences. Association does not establish causation.

THE TAKEAWAY

Price is a combination.
Context makes it meaningful.

Compare the period, the property and the place together.
Use the visualizations to ask better questions—not to infer causation.
